title: The Hess Art Collection

services.name: reserve a tasting
services.desc: We’re delighted to welcome you to our winery on Mount Veeder, where two generations have farmed these mountain slopes since 1978. Join us for bar tasting, a seated Estate Tasting in our courtyard or a guided ATV tour through our mountain vineyards. PLEASE NOTE: Our galleries are in the midst of an exciting refresh. Access to parts of the museum will be limited through the end of the year, and we thank you for your patience as the new exhibition comes together. Visit our state-of-the-art cellar followed by a seated tasting of four reserve tier wines. Culminating in the iconic “The Lion” Mount Veeder Estate Cabernet, this experience focuses on the power and elegance of Napa Valley and beyond.

blurb: Founder Donald Hess’s art collection began when he purchased a painting as décor for his new home. Years later, a friend studied the painting and informed him that he owned a Picasso. This twist of fate gave Donald his first indication that he might have an eye for art curation. Donald Hess formally began collecting art in 1966, and for him, collecting art was a personal endeavor.
